corpus: original model suggestion text with verified acceptance in earlier sessions
finding: No useful primary personal advantage is established. Useful base, pooled and donor advantage is excluded under both interval methods. Uniform advantage is excluded under writer resampling but remains unresolved under crossed resampling. All primary intervals include zero. Adapted-minus-base donor and pooled useful advantages remain unresolved under both methods; its pooled writer interval favors personal adaptation at zero without establishing the useful margin or surviving crossed resampling at zero. Residual uniform advantage is excluded only under writer resampling, narrowly at full precision, and remains unresolved under crossed resampling. All other residual intervals include zero. Raw useful base and pooled advantage remains unresolved under both methods; donor advantage is excluded under writer resampling and unresolved under crossed resampling. Raw base favors personal adaptation at zero only under writer resampling; raw pooled and donor intervals include zero, and raw sums are worse than uniform under both methods. No parity follows.
limits: Previously selected model prose reflects suggestion supply and prior choices, not human-authored text or necessarily final retained wording. Sparse histories, shared or changed human support, fixed donor/global training and exposed prompts bound the recipe. No independent human confirmation, seed/rank/corpus ranking, population limit, private-goal inference or whole-matrix verdict. Earlier failed/unknown attempts remain separate; no new retry.
